claims.assertion: Anéeka describes Taygetan speech as holographic, with telepathic meaning layered on flexible words; Navajo/Inuit spellings only approximate it.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Taygetans call themselves Daughters of Moma in their matriarchal society; their older few-free name recalls expansion and sparse population.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: She dates their freedom cry to about 850,000 years ago during the Great Expansion against reptilian oppression, followed by settlement of a resource-rich uninhabited system.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Anéeka says Taygeta is binary: nearby white-dwarf Sadicleya illuminates its planets and affects biological cycles; they lack natural moons.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
